about: Overall vibration severity zones from ISO 20816-3 (formerly ISO 10816-3) for industrial machines above 15 kW, velocity RMS in mm/s over roughly 10-1000 Hz. Zone A: new machine. B: acceptable for long-term running. C: restricted, plan action. D: damaging. Only applied to channels whose iso_class is set in machines.json and whose Velocity is an RMS value in mm/s. Check the limits against your copy of the standard and your site rules.
